testsuite.name: com.whatsmine.inertia.InertiaProtocolTest

testcase.name: 1. Initial page load (no X-Inertia header) should return HTML bootstrap template with data-page attribute
4. Non-GET Inertia redirect should convert HTTP 302 to 303 See Other
5. Partial reload request should filter props according to X-Inertia-Partial-Data header
2. Inertia AJAX request (X-Inertia: true) should return JSON payload with X-Inertia response header
6. Flash message should be passed in shared props and consumed after initial load
3. Asset version mismatch on GET should return 409 Conflict with X-Inertia-Location header
